Images take on a watercolour-like look, with the texture of the paper helping to add to the overall pleasure of the photo or artwork. Image take on a more matt appearance, with deep blacks, bright whites and more bright pastel-like tones to images. Due to the way the ink sits on the paper, they appear to have slightly less ‘sharpness’ than a silver halide photo print has, but that is the fine art prints charm. This high quality photo printing technique is achieved with a combination of state-of-the-art inkjet heads, placing the finest micro piezo droplets of ink onto a variety of textured fine art, archival grade papers, for colour or black & white images or artwork. We use Epson large format printers (LFPs) combined with Hahnemühle papers for all of our fine art photo printing . Paper - Bamboo 290gsm Bamboo is the world’s first digital fine art inkjet paper made from bamboo fibres. Bamboo represents spirituality, naturalness and resource-saving paper production. It’s particularly suitable for warm-toned colour and monochrome prints; Bamboo really highlights the sensuality of images.. Framing - We only use the very best quality - A simple black polycore moulding Mount: Bright White Paper Finish: Hahnemühle - Bamboo Glazing : Non Reflective Acrylic Hanging Kit: Standard Wall Kit Fine Art Photography Prints Specifications Paper type: Archival grade, 100% acid free, PH neutral Framing Fine Art Photography Prints - Frame shown is a thin black mould. Alternative frames and colours can be supplied as required. If you want a different framing option, then contact me for a quotation .
